about: BABEL's Life Cards (dungeon/life/cards.py, docs/life-cards.md): small things that happen on the tower's floors, on the Stair between them, at a camp off the Safe Zones, and off the page to people the climber knows. A first deck built from Vanta's Mabry Curve archive (dungeon/world/packages/babel/sources.md). Cards leave out 'where' because the region names in cards.py are Vallarith's; the travel map gives BABEL's regions no card region.

cards.title: A new wave
cards.truth: A fresh wave came down at the Waystone overnight: forty-odd arrivals, three of them already Marked.
cards.seen: The plaza is full of people in arrival garb asking where the exit is. The stall-keepers have doubled their prices.
cards.pressure: Somebody in the crowd is asking for the character by name.

cards.title: Osk feeds the house
cards.truth: Osk cooked too much for a guild dinner that never came and is giving it away before it turns.
cards.seen: Osk is ladling stew into any bowl held out. For once a climber can taste it.

cards.title: A bounty on the board
cards.truth: The {faction} posted a clearing job a floor down, and it pays better than it should because two parties already turned back.
cards.seen: A fresh notice on the guild board: a floor to clear, paid in Talents, no questions about rank.

cards.title: The Roll stutters
cards.truth: The Waystone's list skipped a line for a moment. A name that was on the Roll last night is gone.
cards.seen: The Stone flickers. People crowd it reading for their own names, and nobody will say whose is missing.

cards.title: Light fingers
cards.truth: A native boy of twenty cut the character's purse strings in the press by the fire market and is already two rows away.
cards.seen: The purse is lighter. The crowd is the same crowd it was a moment ago.

cards.title: Red in a Safe Zone
cards.truth: A climber struck a native in the plaza, flashed red, and the Landing's people are dragging him out past the gate.
cards.seen: Shouting by the Stone, a man glowing red as a coal, and porters with clubs walking him toward the east gate.
cards.pressure: He catches the character's eye and asks them to vouch for him.

cards.title: No Marked beyond the ford
cards.truth: The {faction} took a Marked woman at the ford for the Pens, with a writ that names no crime.
cards.seen: A woman with the Mark on her throat is led past in a halter. Nobody on the bridge looks at her.
cards.pressure: She says the character's name, or one like it.

cards.title: Something that tastes like home
cards.truth: A cook from an earlier wave has worked out how to make a thing that tastes, almost, like a gas-station burrito.
cards.seen: A queue of climbers at a stall that smells of cumin and wrong cheese. Some of them are crying a little.

cards.title: Porters going the other way
cards.truth: A string of Concourse porters is carrying salt down to the Bazaar and knows the landings ahead.
cards.seen: Six porters under frames, singing a counting song. Their leader points out which landing has fresh water.

cards.title: Mind the stair
cards.truth: A tread worn hollow gives under the character's boot.
cards.seen: One step is not where it was a heartbeat ago, and the Stair drops away past the rail.

cards.title: A chalk tally
cards.truth: An earlier climber marked the landing with initials and a count of days. The last mark is a week old.
cards.seen: Initials and a row of chalk strokes on the landing wall, and an arrow pointing up.

cards.title: A toll on the landing
cards.truth: Three climbers who never got past D rank hold the landing and charge whoever comes up.
cards.seen: Three people in mismatched guild colors sitting across the stair with their weapons out, smiling.
cards.pressure: Pay the toll, talk past them, or fight on a stair with a drop on one side.

cards.title: Something on the Stair
cards.truth: A floor's creatures have wandered onto the Stair, which the System does not count as anyone's floor.
cards.seen: Claws on stone above, coming down, and no Safe Zone for half a day either way.

cards.title: A climber going down
cards.truth: A climber who went too high is coming down alone, and will not say what happened to the rest of his party.
cards.seen: A man in good gear, gray in the face, coming down without stopping. He says only: out is not down.

cards.title: The cage runs late
cards.truth: Cobb's lift cage is stuck between floors while he works the winch by hand.
cards.seen: The cage shudders to a stop in the dark between floors. Cobb swears, pleasantly, and starts cranking.

cards.title: A quiet landing
cards.truth: The landing is out of the wind and nothing has nested in it.
cards.seen: Dry stone, a breeze from the floor below that smells of rain, and real sleep.

cards.title: A cold camp
cards.truth: The fuel is wet and the floor's night runs colder than its day.
cards.seen: No fire will take. The character sleeps in pieces, and wakes stiff.

cards.title: The System at night
cards.truth: The interface offers a skill the character has not earned, and says nothing of what it costs.
cards.seen: A pale window opens in the dark behind the eyelids: a skill offered, Accept or Decline, and no fine print.
cards.pressure: Accept it now, or let it close and wonder.

cards.title: Watchers past the light
cards.truth: Scavengers from the floor below have followed the smell of food up the Stair.
cards.seen: Eyes past the firelight, low to the ground, more of them each time the character looks.

cards.title: Someone is listening
cards.truth: Something teaches in the character's sleep, in a tongue they did not know when they lay down.
cards.seen: They wake knowing three words of a language they never heard, and the feeling that someone stopped talking.

cards.title: A shared fire
cards.truth: A native trapper is glad of company and has a pot big enough for two.
cards.seen: A woman in furs waves the character over to her fire and asks what Earth is like, and whether it's real.

cards.title: Ranked up
cards.truth: {them} cleared a floor boss with a pickup party and went up a rank.
cards.seen: Word on the Concourse is that {them} ranked up, and is buying rounds nobody can taste.

cards.title: In debt to the rows
cards.truth: {them} borrowed against next week's Talents from the {faction} and cannot pay.
cards.seen: {them} has been seen avoiding the fire market, and someone has been asking after them.

cards.title: Hurt on a floor
cards.truth: {them} took a bad wound on a floor run and is laid up at the Landing.
cards.seen: {them} came back down on a porter's frame. The Landing says they will live.

cards.title: A new party
cards.truth: {them} joined a party heading up and is doing well with it.
cards.seen: {them} has new guild colors and new friends, and looks less frightened than they did.

cards.title: Tethered
cards.truth: {them} swore a Tether to someone in a hurry, and the System counted it.
cards.seen: {them} is wearing someone else's mark at the wrist and blushes when asked about it.

cards.title: Marked
cards.truth: {them} took the Mark on another floor and was sold on before the {faction} could be stopped.
cards.seen: {them} has not been seen on the Concourse in days. A trader says someone with their face was in a halter at the ford.

cards.title: No longer climbing
cards.truth: {them} went up past where the Roll can see and did not come back.
cards.seen: {them} is still on the Waystone's list, but the line beside their name now reads: no longer climbing.
